group.description: A group of two tweaks, sharing the data and script above them

@group.description: Names the file's group at the top, or past it opens a nested one that runs to its @end

subgroup.description: A group in a group, with a shared part and a box of its own, up to its @end

@use.description: In a group's shared part or a lone tweak, before its code: loads a script library, like the Cheat Engine layer ce

@children.description: Right after a @group: what its box does to what's in it

@globals.description: In a group's shared part, before its code: plain global writes from anything in the group land in its top level, where they all see them

tweak.description: A tweak with a name, a key and some data

inject.description: Asm before the instruction there, which still runs after it

patch.description: Asm that replaces the code there, what expect matches

toggle.description: A checkbox field with a key

choices.description: A field picked from a list your script makes

hook.description: Script in place of a function, which can call the original

luahook.description: Lua in place of a function, which can call the original

jspatch.description: JS in place of the code there, with cpu, original() and resume()

luapatch.description: Lua in place of the code there, with cpu, original() and resume()

js.description: JS that runs when it's turned on

lua.description: Lua that runs when it's turned on
